info.title: StellarSettle API
info.description: API specification for StellarSettle backend including Soroban contract interactions.

contractId.description: The Soroban contract ID managing the escrow

invoiceIds.description: Ids of the draft invoices to publish.

userId.description: User whose approval is being withdrawn.

revocationReason.description: Recorded in the KYC audit log.

maxBuyPerTx.description: Maximum amount purchasable in a single buy transaction, in base units

maxBuyPerDay.description: Maximum amount purchasable per wallet per day, in base units

currentSupply.description: Current key supply, in base units

keyAddress.description: Creator key contract that split the royalty.

buyerWallet.description: Buyer that paid the transfer, when the event carried it.

amount.description: Royalty amount credited in token units.

ledgerSequence.description: Ledger the royalty was paid in.

keyAddress.description: Creator key the royalty was accrued under.

cycleFrequency.description: Configured distribution frequency for the cycle.

earned.description: Amount allocated to the wallet for the cycle.

claimed.description: Amount of the allocation already claimed.

totalClaimed.description: Sum of every claim by the wallet.

distributionId.description: Distribution cycle the claim came from.

cycleFrequency.description: Configured distribution frequency for the cycle.

cycleCount.description: Number of cycles the wallet was allocated in.

keyId.description: Contract id or key identifier the status was checked against.

subscribed.description: True when the balance meets the minimum and has not expired.

expiryLedger.description: Ledger the current subscription lapses after.

daysRemaining.description: Whole days until expiry; 0 once expired.

ledger.description: Ledger the answer was read at.

completedAt.description: RFC 3339 completion time, preserved across repeat calls.

updatedAt.description: RFC 3339 time of the last write.

/api/v1/admin.description: Administrative routes are defined under this prefix.

get.description: Returns the whitelisted contract integrations and the functions each may call, projected from ACLUpdated contract events. Cached for five minutes and invalidated whenever a new ACLUpdated event is indexed. Admin only.
Returns the append-only audit trail of ACL changes derived from ACLUpdated events, newest first. Admin only.

post.description: Withdraws a previously granted KYC approval, returning the user to the pending state so they can be reviewed again. Only an approved user can be revoked. Requires the admin API key and an allow-listed source IP.

get.description: Claimable dividend amounts per distribution cycle for the authenticated holder wallet, derived from synced DividendDistributed / DividendClaimed events. Cached for 30 seconds and invalidated by dividend events.
Dividends the authenticated holder wallet has claimed, newest first, with amounts and the on-chain transaction that paid them. Cursor paginated.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's meta.nextCursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page.

get.description: Lifetime earned, claimed and pending dividend totals for the authenticated holder wallet, aggregated across every distribution cycle the wallet was allocated in.

get.summary: List the authenticated investor's portfolios and payouts

200.description: List the authenticated investor's portfolios and payouts

get.summary: Export the investor's payout history as CSV

post.description: Publishes several of the authenticated seller's draft invoices to the marketplace in a single atomic transaction. Every invoice is validated first; if any one of them cannot be published the whole batch is rejected and no invoice changes state. The 400 response lists every rejected invoice and why.

400.description: Batch rejected; no invoice was changed

get.description: Retrieves the on-chain escrow status for a specific invoice via Soroban smart contracts.
Returns the creator key configuration, including the per-transaction buy limit. Public read; the limit is enforced on-chain.

get.summary: Get per-transaction buy limit for a creator key
get.description: Pre-trade check: returns the per-transaction buy cap (max_buy_per_tx) and the current key supply so the frontend can clamp the buy input before submitting a transaction. Public read, cached for 60 seconds and invalidated when a key configuration update event is indexed.

get.summary: List bonding curve migrations for a creator key
get.description: Returns the migration proposals indexed from CurveMigrationProposed / CurveMigrationExecuted events, each with the proposed parameters, timelock expiry and status. Executed migrations are visible to any authenticated user; migrations still behind the timelock are creator-only.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status; `pending` requires creator access

post.description: Updates verification and user KYC state after validating the provider HMAC signature.

get.summary: List invoices available on the secondary marketplace

200.description: List invoices available on the secondary marketplace

get.summary: List invoices available on the secondary marketplace

200.description: List invoices available on the secondary marketplace

post.description: Records that the authenticated wallet finished the onboarding tour. Idempotent: re-completing keeps the original completedAt timestamp.

get.description: Whether the authenticated wallet has completed the onboarding tour, and when. Called on every app load, so it is a single indexed row lookup.

Lifetime royalty accruals, claims and the outstanding balance for the authenticated creator, with a per-transfer breakdown. Creator-only (seller or both) and scoped to the token's wallet. Figures are cached for 30 seconds and invalidated by royalty events.

parameters.name: transfer_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of royalty transfers to return (1-200).

403.description: The authenticated wallet is not a creator

get.description: Royalties the authenticated creator has claimed, newest first, with the on-chain transaction that paid them. Cursor paginated and creator-only.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's meta.nextCursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page.

403.description: The authenticated wallet is not a creator

get.description: Whether a wallet holds the minimum key balance required to access gated content, with the expiry ledger and whole days remaining. Public by design: a content gate has to answer before the visitor is known to the platform, and the response only reflects public on-chain holdings. Cached for 30 seconds and evicted when a holding-change event is observed.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Stellar account (strkey) public key to check.

parameters.name: key_id
parameters.description: Soroban contract id, or the key identifier the contract uses.

400.description: 'wallet' is missing or malformed, or 'key_id' is missing or malformed

get.summary: List atomic swaps for the authenticated wallet
get.description: Returns every atomic swap where the authenticated wallet is either the buyer or the seller, keyset-paginated on (executed_at, id).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's meta.nextCursor

get.description: Public lookup of one atomic swap by its id or on-chain swap id.
